title: Uncertainty-Aware NBA Forecasting + Isotonic Calibration (Jan 2026 SOTA)

sota_benchmarks.source: MDPI Information 2026-01 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets

key_findings: RNN with Monte Carlo dropout + team-level metrics + rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings achieves Brier ~0.199
CalibratedClassifierCV with isotonic regression improves calibration by ~0.001-0.003 over raw model probabilities
Shot-chart spatial embeddings (5-zone clustering of NBA.com data) identified as key missing feature vs our fleet
Rolling-form velocity features (last 5/10 game momentum) identified as high-value addition
Strict chronological partitioning (train≤2022, val 2023, test 2024) aligns with our walk-forward methodology
Stacked ensemble (Nature Sci Reports 2025) achieves accuracy 68-71% with XGBoost+RF+LR stack

proposed_actions.action: Add isotonic calibration post-processing to S22 VennAbers output — test if it compounds or conflicts
Add rolling-form velocity features to features/engine.py v3.2: last_5_win_rate, last_10_elo_delta, home_away_form_streak
Explore spatial shot-chart zone features (5 zones): restricted_area%, midrange%, corner_3%, above_break_3%, long_midrange%
